image_description: A high-angle shot of a wooden restaurant table featuring two plates of food (one with sushi rolls, one with fried appetizers), a glass of dark liquid, and several paper menus. One menu is open in the center background, another is closed on the left, and a red promotional stand-up menu is visible on the right edge. Partial views of two people are present at the top corners.

artifact_observations.location: Red menu on the right edge
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the red menu is nonsensical. Characters are malformed, fused, and do not form readable words, which is a common AI artifact in rendering small text.
The text lines on the central menu are excessively blurred and lack the sharp edges expected of printed ink, appearing more like smudged textures.
The sushi rolls appear slightly melted into the plate surface, lacking distinct separation boundaries between the food and the ceramic.
The elliptical perspective of the glass rim seems slightly inconsistent with the table plane, appearing slightly warped.
